title: THE KRAKEN OF THE REDWYNE STRAITS
narrative: Euron stands at the prow of the Silence, his one smiling blue eye gleaming as his Valyrian steel armor drinks the lightning. Chained to the hulls of twenty warships are priests of every faith — Septons, Red Priests, Drowned Men, and warlocks of Qarth. The horn Dragonbinder roars with a sound like dying gods. Blood churns the water black. From the abyssal trenches of the Sunset Sea, tentacled monstrosities broader than galleons rise from the deep, snapping the Redwyne fleet like dry kindling. 'The world is a blank page,' Euron laughs into the gale. 'And I am the ink!'

options.text: Direct the leviathans north into the Shivering Sea to batter the Wall from the coast.
Seize the vaults of Oldtown and unlock the forbidden Valyrian blood scrolls.
Sail directly up the Mander to sack Highgarden and claim the Reach.
Aeron Damphair: Lash the holy priests to the prows of the Silence for the blood tithe.
Ascend the Hightower: Lord Leyton and the Mad Maid light the obsidian glass candles.
The Citadel Thieves: Pate delivers the stolen Archmaester master key to the Alchemist.
The Triple Identity: Daario removes his blue beard to reveal Euron, who reveals Benjen Stark.
